messages:
maria: Morning folks — who can take the 14:00 UTC train today? We have the model-serving PR (heatmap cache change) + a small console CSS tweak.

devon: I can own model-serving. Need ~30m prep to warm cache + one manual regression check. ETA ready by 13:30 UTC?

kevin: I’ll pick up the console CSS. Staging passed, tiny risk on hero banner. Plan to push at 14:05 UTC for my lane.

sara: Ops note — platform prefers a 15m gap between canaries so metrics can stabilize. Can we stagger: model-serving at 14:00, console at 14:15?

ops-bot: Scheduled window confirmed for 14:00-15:00 UTC. Canary policy: staggered(15m). Autoretry/alert hooks enabled.

maria: Awesome. devon — can you add the smoke checklist link here? Also call out any warming steps.

devon: Added checklist: https://internal/ops/smoke-checklist. Smoke run steps I’ll follow:
```
1. curl -sS https://staging.service/health || exit 1
2. ./scripts/check-latency --qps 100 --p95-target 200ms
3. tail -n 200 /var/log/serving.log | grep -i 'kv-cache'
```
I’ll run prefix-cache-warm 20m before deploy.

kevin: FYI I’ll monitor console errors. Rollback command if things go bad: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/console -n prod`

sara: Ops will be on standby. @devon @kevin please post smoke status here. If any regression, ping @oncall-release immediately.

devon: Noted. I’ll start at 14:00 and will post: `model-serving: started` -> `smoke: pass/fail` entries.

kevin: Will deploy at 14:15, run my smoke checklist and post results back here.

maria: Quick CR ping — @kevin can you approve #4521? It's blocking the console tweak rollout.

kevin: On it, giving LGTM now.

sara: One more ask — keep feature-flag `new-embed-cache` OFF for the first canary. devon, flip only after green across primary metrics.

devon: Will deploy with flag OFF. If everything looks good I’ll flip at ~14:30 UTC.

maria: Sweet. I’ll update the release board and notify stakeholders. Good luck :rocket:

ops-bot: Reminder: rollback window ends at 15:00 UTC.
